'''Vulcan''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Forgotten Skull}} and {{Zone|Dungeon Hub}} who offers a [[Crimson Isle]] perk shop after defeating [[Kuudra]].

== Trivia ==
*'''Vulcan''' is a reference to the [[w:Vulcan (mythology)|Roman god of the same name]]. They were the God of Fire, Deserts, Forge and Volcanoes.
*'''Harena Fortuna''' is the Spanish for 'sand fortune', despite the perk only activating with {{Item|Red Sand}} and not regular {{Item|Sand}}.
